The '''Kalamith sector''' was part of the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Kalamith sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
